question: Can one public engineered-protease study supply exact construct identities, exact substrate sequences, product-verified intended bonds, matched quantitative positives, and a bounded quantitative negative before any computational scoring rule is selected?

source.title: Phage-assisted continuous evolution of proteases with altered substrate specificity

required: at least one matched positive and one quantitative negative or censored upper bound
common assay chemistry and stated conditions
eligibility_rule.scope: A four-cell calibration panel only; it is not an untouched holdout, a broad specificity benchmark, or evidence of de novo design success.

proteases.source_identity: Mature 242-residue TEV NIa protease sequence from UniProt P04517 with the self-cleavage-resistant S219V substitution; the paper explicitly calls this construct wild-type.
proteases.source_locator: Main text, first PACE validation paragraph

proteases.source_identity: TEV_S219V_paper_wild_type plus the complete 20-nonsilent-mutation genotype listed below; Addgene plasmid MSP851 / 98798 is the deposited expression construct.
proteases.disambiguation: Use Supplementary Table 11's selected L2F genotype. Do not substitute the different trajectory-2 stage-8 representative in main Table 1, which carries T146C rather than L2F's T146S.

substrates.full_length_product_confirmation: LC-MS of cleaved heterodimeric human IL-23 found one product 3598 Da below the starting IL-23p19 mass, matching cleavage at HPLVGH/M.
substrates.protein_context_limit: With isolated IL-23p19 and excess L2F, LC-MS also supported secondary cleavage at ARVFAH/G. The peptide-panel target positive therefore does not establish unique-site specificity in every protein context.

assay.readout: Reverse-phase C18 HPLC quantification against synthetic cleaved-product standard curves at 355 nm
assay.reaction_conditions: 0.05-0.1 micromolar protease, 50 micromolar to 2 millimolar substrate, 30 C, 10 min; progress constrained below 25 percent substrate consumption and fitted to Michaelis-Menten kinetics.
assay.negative_control_condition: For wild-type TEV on HPLVGHM, no product was observed after 30 min with 1 micromolar protease and 2 millimolar substrate; product limit of detection was 1 nanomolar.
assay.replication: Kinetic reactions were conducted in triplicate after time-course checks.
assay.source_locator: Methods, HPLC kinetics assay; main Table 2 footnote

matched_matrix.censoring: No product above the 1 nanomolar HPLC detection limit after 30 min at 1 micromolar protease and 2 millimolar substrate; do not replace this bound with zero or a fitted kinetic constant.

decision.supported_use: Freeze these four cells as an exposed calibration challenge for whether a future sequence/structure score ranks the evolved target gain while preserving the observed native-substrate activity. The primary contrast is the protease-by-substrate interaction, not the absolute difference between unrelated assays.
unsupported_uses: training or selecting a model and then calling the same four cells an independent test
estimating generalization across protease families or target proteins
claiming product identity for every phage-display specificity-library member
claiming that IL-23 LC-MS verifies every peptide-matrix cell; it independently verifies only L2F cleavage at the target bond in protein context
treating the censored negative as exact zero
computing only on the core heptapeptides without freezing that crop before scoring; the assayed substrates include the listed flanks and DNP-lysine
validating de novo metalloprotease design or transferring TEV subsite geometry to zinc proteases

strongest_feasible_alternatives.qPISA: More than 40000 exact peptides and two matched exopeptidases with quantitative substrate depletion, but individual products and scissile bonds are not verified per peptide.
strongest_feasible_alternatives.CleaveNet_MMP_panel: A 95-substrate by 12-MMP replicated quantitative FRET matrix, but fluorophore separation does not localize or identify the cleavage product.
strongest_feasible_alternatives.MSP_MS_proteasome_panel: LC-MS/MS-localized cut sites across exact peptides, but non-observed sites are censored rather than calibrated quantitative negatives.

decision.stopping_rule_met: Yes. One compact qualifying panel was found. Stop source search and do not expand it with heterogeneous native-protease panels unless a future scoring question needs more than this four-cell calibration and states a new eligibility rule first.

source_acquisition.counting_scope: BioC article JSON, NCBI ID conversion, PMC article XML, Europe PMC full-text XML, and two complete supplementary archives. Search-index lookups are not represented as byte-exact downloads.
source_acquisition.relationship_to_retained_v3_batch: Separate question and source; does not reset or consume the retained Chen-v3 batch recorded in the handoff.
